title: observability-token-kv-dashboard-enhancements-alert-tuning
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: Recent customer incidents and internal perf regressions highlighted gaps in token-level KV cache visibility and noisy alerts for token-cost spikes. ENG-4128 requested improved dashboards to show token-level and KV cache metrics by model/route, and ENG-4210 asked for alert tuning to reduce pager noise while preserving SLO coverage. Summary: This PR adds new panels to the Token/KV Observability dashboard, consolidates cost/latency breakdowns per model and route, and adjusts several alert thresholds and evaluation windows. Changes include new aggregated token-cost metrics, refined KV hit/miss tracing tags, per-route latency percentiles, and a short-term anomaly detector to suppress transient token-cost spikes. Detailed changes (high level): - New dashboard panels: token_cost_per_model, token_cost_per_route, kv_cache_hit_rate, kv_cache_miss_latency, per_route_p50_p95_p99_latency, token_cost_anomaly_summary. - Metrics: emit two new metrics from serving: redwood.tokens.cost_per_token (labels: model, route, deployment_zone) and redwood.kv.cache_miss_latency_ms (labels: model, route, node). - Tracing: add span attributes for kv_cache.{hit,miss} and attach token_count and cost_estimate tags to top-level request span for downstream correlation. - Alerts: tuned token-cost spike alert to a 5m sustained window with dynamic baseline (reduce noise from bursts), lowered KV miss rate alert to 0.5% with 10m window for Dedicated clusters, and added a silencing rule during canary rollouts. - Docs & runbook: updated observability runbook with investigation steps and example queries; added migration notes for dashboard users. Checklist: - [x] Dashboard panels added and validated in staging - [x] Metrics emitted by runtime with feature flag defaulted on in staging - [x] Alerts tuned and tested with synthetic data - [x] Runbook updated and linked in release notes Impact / Rollout plan: Feature gated metrics and tracing are behind a feature flag (observability.kv_enhanced). Rollout: enable in staging -> monitor dashboards for 24h -> enable in selected Dedicated clusters -> full rollout. Alerts will be deployed alongside dashboards; SRE will monitor for unexpected misses. Why this matters: The new dashboards give product and SRE teams finer-grained cost attributions (token-level) and make it easier to identify model/route hotspots and KV cache regressions. Alert tuning should reduce pagers by ~40% for transient spikes while preserving detection for true regressions. Merge notes: Squash-merged after CI green and two approvals. No migrations required for customers; dashboards added to managed Grafana org and available to internal tenants after rollout.
commits: feat(observability): add token_cost_per_token metric and associated tags
chore(observability): add dashboard JSON + panels for token and KV metrics
fix(alerts): tune token-cost spike alert to 5m sustained window and add canary silence rule

Liam O'Connor: Can we avoid emitting cost estimates for PII-sensitive routes? Suggest feature flag behavior and docs note. Maya Patel: Added label filtering to metrics emitter and documented the privacy-safe default (cost_estimate not emitted for routes tagged pii=true).

Sofia Martinez: Verified dashboard panels in staging and validated queries against synthetic traffic. Suggest adding p50/p95/p99 split by route which was implemented. Maya Patel: Thanks - added the percentiles and updated queries.
Arjun Kumar: Approving after CI green and runbook updated. Liam O'Connor: Approving - small nits addressed.
CI Bot: All checks passed on second run (flake fixed).
